parameters.query:
SELECT 
    t.id, 
    t.name, 
    t.testgrade, 
    COALESCE(s.name, 'Unknown') as subject_name 
FROM tests t 
LEFT JOIN ecsubjects s ON t.testsubjectarea = s.id 
WHERE t.id = {{ $json.test_id }}

SELECT 
    q.id, 
    q.name, 
    q.type, 
    q.points, 
    q.qorder, 
    COALESCE(h.htmlmod, h.html, '') as html 
FROM questions q 
LEFT JOIN questionobjecthtml h ON q.id = h.questionid 
WHERE q.testid = {{ $json.id }} 
  AND q.excluded = 0 
ORDER BY q.qorder

SELECT 
    qo.questionid, 
    qo.answer, 
    COALESCE(qo.answertextmod, qo.answertext, '') as answertext, 
    ISNULL(qo.iscorrect, 0) as iscorrect 
FROM questionobjects qo 
INNER JOIN questions q ON qo.questionid = q.id 
WHERE q.testid = {{ $('Get Test Info').first().json.id }} 
  AND q.excluded = 0 
ORDER BY qo.questionid, qo.answer
